title: Pure Obelisk the Tormentor
summary: Pure Obelisk the Tormentor build centered on Tribute Summoning Seto Kaiba's 4000 ATK/DEF DIVINE Divine-Beast via the Slime engine, Angel O1, and Soul Crossing, then resolving Obelisk's signature Spell Speed 4 board-breakers Fist of Fate and Soul Energy MAX!!!

summary.title: Starters
points: Reactor Slime Special Summons 2 Slime Tokens during your Main Phase (assembling 3 Tributes alongside itself), or tributes itself during the Battle Phase to Set Metal Reflect Slime from your Deck, which can be activated that same turn.
Angel O1 reveals Obelisk the Tormentor in your hand to Special Summon itself from the hand, and while on the field grants an extra Tribute Summon of a Level 7+ monster in Attack Position.
Soul Crossing Tribute Summons a Divine-Beast during either Main Phase as a Quick-Play Spell by Tributing up to 3 monsters from either side of the field, including your opponent's monsters.

summary.title: Opening: Reactor Slime + Obelisk (or Angel O1 + Obelisk)
steps: Normal Summon Reactor Slime and activate its effect to Special Summon 2 Slime Tokens (giving you 3 monsters on field); if you also have Angel O1, reveal Obelisk the Tormentor in hand to Special Summon Angel O1 for an extra Tribute Summon.

Alternatively, tribute a Level 10 WATER Aqua with 0 ATK (Guardian Slime or activated Metal Reflect Slime) to Special Summon Egyptian God Slime from the Extra Deck, which counts as 1 or 3 Tributes for a Tribute Summon.

Tribute Summon Obelisk the Tormentor in Attack Position using Egyptian God Slime or the 3 Slime bodies, activate Mound of the Bound Creator, and Set Fist of Fate, The Breaking Ruin God, or Soul Energy MAX!!!

summary.title: Obelisk's Protection & Tribute Summon
summary.text: Obelisk the Tormentor's Normal Summon cannot be negated, cards and effects cannot be activated when it is Normal Summoned, and neither player can target Obelisk with card effects. While Special Summoned Obelisks send themselves to the GY during the End Phase, a Tribute Summoned Obelisk stays permanently on the field, and Mound of the Bound Creator adds effect-destruction immunity to Level 10+ monsters so Obelisk is both untargetable and indestructible.

summary.title: Bosses & Defense
points: Obelisk the Tormentor (4000 ATK / 4000 DEF) tributes 2 monsters to destroy all monsters the opponent controls.

Egyptian God Slime (3000 ATK / 3000 DEF) cannot be destroyed by battle, stops the opponent from attacking your other monsters or targeting them with card effects, and serves as a single-monster 3-Tribute fodder for Obelisk.
Guardian Slime Special Summons itself from the hand when you take battle or effect damage and gains DEF equal to the attacking monster's ATK.

summary.title: Signature Spells & Traps
points: Fist of Fate (Quick-Play Spell): its activation and effect cannot be negated; while you control Obelisk, it negates 1 Effect Monster the opponent controls and destroys it (plus negates effects of monsters with that name for the turn), then during your Main Phase also destroys all Spells and Traps they control.

The Breaking Ruin God (Quick-Play Spell): its activation and effect cannot be negated; Special Summons Obelisk from your hand or GY unaffected by the opponent's card effects, and if Obelisk destroys a monster by battle that turn, banishes all monsters with that name from their GY and inflicts 1000 damage per monster.

Soul Energy MAX!!! tributes 2 other face-up monsters while you control Obelisk to destroy all opponent's monsters and inflict 4000 burn damage, and banishes itself from the GY during the Main Phase or Battle Phase (by discarding a card) to add Obelisk from your Deck or GY to your hand and immediately Normal Summon it.

allow.Metal Reflect Slime: Continuous Trap Monster Set directly from your Deck by Reactor Slime that summons itself as a Level 10 WATER Aqua with 0 ATK / 3000 DEF, immediately transforming into Egyptian God Slime (which counts as 3 Tributes for Obelisk the Tormentor!).
allow.Mound of the Bound Creator: Field Spell that protects Level 10 Obelisk the Tormentor from being destroyed by card effects, burns for 1000 when Obelisk destroys a monster by battle, and searches Obelisk the Tormentor from your Deck when destroyed!

main: Obelisk the Tormentor

Fist of Fate

The Breaking Ruin God

Mound of the Bound Creator
Field Spell that makes Level 10 Obelisk the Tormentor indestructible by card effects and searches Obelisk from your Deck if destroyed.
Soul Energy MAX!!!

Metal Reflect Slime
Set directly from your Deck by Reactor Slime; summons itself as a Level 10 WATER Aqua with 0 ATK to tribute for Egyptian God Slime.
extra: Level 10 WATER Aqua Fusion boss (3000 ATK / 3000 DEF): Special Summoned by Tributing a Level 10 WATER Aqua with 0 ATK (Guardian Slime or Metal Reflect Slime); cannot be destroyed by battle, protects your other monsters, and can be treated as 1 OR 3 Tributes for the Tribute Summon of Obelisk the Tormentor!
